description: Données GTFS - Transport - bus urbains de la CAPA is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CAPA. Données transport urbain: bus de la CAPA (Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien) Données GTFS téléchargeables via l'export alternatif. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are transport, bus, transport urbain, gtfs. The portal shows 14 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
